items.desc: Germany's parliament has backed a plan to help children save for retirement from the age of 6. Meanwhile, Jewish students report death threats after they confronted a far-right lawmaker. DW has the latest.

items.title: How prepared is Kenya for an Ebola outbreak?
items.titleOrig: How prepared is Kenya for an Ebola outbreak?
items.desc: The first two confirmed Ebola cases in Kenya have raised urgent questions about the country's public health preparedness and border controls. But the Health Ministry says there is no need for panic.

items.title: Italy cuts air traffic in half amid data transmission issue
items.titleOrig: Italy cuts air traffic in half amid data transmission issue
items.desc: Citing problems with the data transmission network, Italian authorities have drastically reduced the volume of flights in their airspace. The ENAV authority ruled out malicious activity and said flights remained safe.

items.title: Clashes erupt at Argentine student protests against President Milei's austerity policies
items.titleOrig: Clashes erupt at Argentine student protests against President Milei's austerity policies
items.desc: Demonstrators clashed with police as President Javier Milei's decision not to release funding for universities brought students and employees to the streets. Protesters say the country's future is at stake.

items.title: Who was Eva Mamlok? Berlin square renamed after Jewish anti-fascist resistance fighter
items.titleOrig: Who was Eva Mamlok? Berlin square renamed after Jewish anti-fascist resistance fighter
items.desc: She started taking action against Hitler as a teenager and never stopped until her death in a concentration camp. Berlin's Blücherplatz is now being renamed after her.

items.title: EU promotes sovereign, trusted AI as it struggles to catch US and China
items.titleOrig: EU promotes sovereign, trusted AI as it struggles to catch US and China
items.desc: At an international AI summit in Dublin, EU leaders promoted trusted and independent artificial intelligence. Critics question whether the bloc can close the gap with the US and China while maintaining strict regulation.

items.title: Formula One in Rwanda: Sportswashing claims vs. hopes for African legacy
items.titleOrig: Formula One in Rwanda: Sportswashing claims vs. hopes for African legacy
items.desc: Formula One will return to Africa for the first time since 1993. There is concern Rwanda are using it as another sportswashing opportunity, but there is also hope the event's legacy can impact wider African society.

items.title: California wildfires force evacuations near Malibu
items.titleOrig: California wildfires force evacuations near Malibu
items.desc: A fast-moving fire near Malibu has forced evacuations. Stronger overnight winds threaten to spread the flames further.

items.title: Wildfire kills 4 firefighters in Indonesia's Mount Bromo national park
items.titleOrig: Wildfire kills 4 firefighters in Indonesia's Mount Bromo national park
items.desc: The latest victims of Indonesia's wildfires were trapped by thick smoke and fast-spreading flames, authorities said. Meanwhile, the toxic haze from the fires has spread to Indonesia's neighbors.

items.title: India: CJP's Dipke detained amid call for fresh Delhi demo
items.titleOrig: India: CJP's Dipke detained amid call for fresh Delhi demo
items.desc: Police placed the founder of the Cockroach Janta Party, Abhijeet Dipke, in preventive detention. He was calling for a protest in central Delhi in defiance of a court order banning it. DW has more.
